result.stdout:
USAGE: ProteomIQon.RatioLFQ [--help] --iontable <path> --outputdirectory <path>
                            --paramfile <path>

OPTIONS:

    --iontable, -i <path> Specify the peptide ion table, GlobModAggregation.txt
                          of LabeledProteinQuantification written without a
                          transform.
    --outputdirectory, -o <path>
                          Specify the output directory. RatioLFQ.txt and the
                          log file are written into it.
    --paramfile, -p <path>
                          Specify parameter file.
    --help                display this list of options.
